title: Schedule
name: Name
staleCounts: These counts may be out of date. Refresh the roster to try again.
sessionStarted: This session has started and cannot be cancelled.
sessionStartedNoteLost: This session has started and cannot be cancelled. Your cancellation note was not sent.
cancelNotify: Email the {count} booked and waitlisted members
cancelNotifyOne: Email the 1 booked or waitlisted member
cancelNotifyNone: No booked or waitlisted members to email
cancelText: Text the {count} booked and waitlisted members
cancelTextOne: Text the 1 booked or waitlisted member
cancelTextNone: No booked or waitlisted members to text
cancelTextHint: Texts go to each member's own phone when they agreed to notices texts, otherwise to their household's billing phone when it agreed to them, and only while Member texts is on in Settings → Go-live.
cancelNote: Optional cancellation note (email only, up to 1,000 characters)
restoreHelp: Brings this class back and restores the places its cancellation cancelled: booked members first, up to the capacity, then the waitlist in its order. Places members cancelled themselves stay cancelled.
restoreEmail: Email the members whose places come back
restoreText: Text the members whose places come back
restored: Class restored. The places its cancellation cancelled are back.
restoredNone: Class restored. No places came back; members can book it again.
restoredNoneNoNotice: Class restored. No places came back, so no notice was sent; members can book it again.
notCancelled: This session isn't cancelled any more. No notice was queued.
restoreStarted: This session has started and can't be restored.
error: Unable to save or load the schedule. Check the fields and try again.
conflict: This record changed or is in use. Reload before trying again.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view the schedule.
timeHelp: Times use the gym timezone. Times skipped by daylight saving are unavailable; repeated times use the first occurrence.
templateHelp: Weekly classes generate sessions nightly, eight weeks ahead. Edits apply to dates that have not been generated. Existing sessions keep their details and overrides.
deleteTemplateConfirm: Delete this weekly class? Existing sessions and attendance will be kept.
alreadyCancelled: This session is already cancelled. No cancellation notice was queued.
moved: Session moved. Its bookings and attendance moved with it.
occupied: Another session of this weekly class already starts at exactly this time. Choose a different start time.
invalidTime: That time doesn't exist in the gym timezone (clocks change that day). Choose another time.
moveHelp: Changes apply to this session only. Its bookings and attendance stay with it, and its weekly class won't create it again at the old time.
editHelp: Changes apply to this session only. Its bookings and attendance stay with it.
loadFailed: The schedule couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
emptyFiltered: No sessions match these filters this week
emptyHelp: Add a weekly class to fill the calendar, or add a one-off session.
noTemplatesHelp: Weekly classes fill the calendar automatically. Use New weekly class to add one.
templateCapacityHelp: Changing it also updates upcoming sessions of this class that still have its old capacity. Sessions with their own capacity keep it.
templateCapacityBelowBooked: An upcoming session of this class has more booked members than that capacity. Choose a higher capacity, or change that session on its own.
coachesHelp: Coaches come from staff profiles. Add one in Staff → Staff profiles, and link it to a login to coach from your own account.
coachesHelpAsk: Coaches come from staff profiles. Ask an owner or admin to add one.
